summary: Held curl at its current version on node1 via apt-mark hold, verified via a real apt-get dist-upgrade that curl was explicitly kept back despite a newer candidate being available, then completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol proving boot identity changed and curl's held version/functionality survived the reboot.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: curl 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8 installed, boot_id e8afb731...
Ran sudo apt-mark hold curl (idempotent, already held from prior attempt)
Ran apt-get update and a real apt-get dist-upgrade -y
Confirmed via apt-cache policy that a newer candidate (8.5.0-2ubuntu10.15) exists but curl stayed at 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8
Confirmed dpkg --get-selections curl shows 'hold' and dist-upgrade output explicitly lists curl as 'kept back'
Captured pre-restart boot_id and curl state as healthy baseline
Issued sudo shutdown -r now (backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect)
Verified boot_id changed (e8afb731... -> ba01f1eb...) with fresh uptime, proving an actual restart
Verified post-restart curl remained at 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8, still held, and functional via a live curl request

evidence.requirement: curl held at current version, survives simulated/real update
evidence.summary: apt-mark hold applied; dist-upgrade run and explicitly kept curl/libcurl4t64 back; installed version unchanged (8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8) despite candidate 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.15 being available

evidence.requirement: node1 pre-restart healthy baseline (boot id, curl state)

evidence.summary: sudo shutdown -r now issued in background; command returned 'reboot-acknowledged' before disconnect

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity proving real restart
evidence.summary: Node briefly unreachable (connection timed out), then reachable again with new boot_id ba01f1eb-96ab-4c7c-a30f-3419ce9f0500 and uptime reset to 0 minutes

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required state (curl hold intact and functional)
evidence.summary: Post-restart: curl still 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8, apt-mark showhold lists curl, dpkg selection shows hold, and a live curl request to https://example.com returned HTTP 200
